summary_en: 1,000,000 shares (2.36% of shares outstanding, ex-treasury) to be acquired; ¥5.0B upper limit; execution via open-market and ToSTNeT-3; 3 August 2026 to 28 May 2027; stated purpose: shareholder returns and capital efficiency improvement.
title_en: Notice regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: On 13 July 2026, the board of Sakata Seed Corporation resolved to acquire up to 1,000,000 treasury shares at a maximum aggregate cost of ¥5.0 billion. The shares represent 2.36% of shares outstanding (calculated against 42,336,255 shares ex-treasury as of 31 May 2026). Acquisition will be executed via both open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange and off-auction ToSTNeT-3 trades between 3 August 2026 and 28 May 2027. The stated rationale is enhancement of shareholder returns and capital efficiency. No maximum price per share is specified in the disclosure.
